decisions.t5: T5 (2026-10-05, review I1, orchestrator decision delegated by the player): four required targets carry gate: true (res_ultimate, res_own_cap, absorption, rr_main); Score = band low + width x G x (0.8 x R + 0.2 x M), G = weighted share met over the required targets, a required target within its tolerance (tight) counts as met there (rule 9.2), a real gap with its credit. Before (T4) R_floor only damped the reserve term (at most ~7 of 33 points), so a build with a resistance 30 below its cap still reached 92 next to 93 for every target just met; a gate over all floor targets was measured and rejected (Cpt Wolf, all nine resistances capped, lost 6 points for Freeze and Life Leech Res, the glass cannon 85 sat next to him at 86). No weight or threshold changed
decisions.t4: T4 (2026-10-04): every target is a floor (works up to its threshold, above it only a buffer) or scaling (keeps paying off); weights per target; new targets rr_main (resistance reduction of the main type, three kinds weighted 0.5/0.3/0.2) and dummy_ttk_mid/_end (Training Dummy shield time); Score = band low + width x (0.8 x R + 0.2 x M x R_floor)
decisions.t3: T3 (2026-10-04): six areas - Health is its own area (the six health targets), Life Leech Resistance moved from Sustain to Resistances (Sustain is now own life leech, low-health triggers and a panic button, from the game database, no targets); no threshold changed
decisions.t2: T2 (2026-10-01): player-readable labels only, no threshold changed
decisions.ravager_target: own cap + resistance reduction of the boss from the game database (39 / 25), fact; the players' +55 buffer is a bonus value only
decisions.early_scaling: Health and DA targets in EARLY scale linearly with the level up to the MID target at level 85
decisions.slow_res: 50% community target for SR and attack/leech builds, never critical
decisions.community_in_score: fact and community targets both count in the score (user 30.09.2026); community targets are never called critical

score.source: user decision 04.10.2026: R = weighted share met over all targets, M = weighted reserve over the margin targets (scaling targets: full at 150% of the target, Health and the dummy time at 300% - user 04.10.2026 'more life and more damage always help'; resistances: mean over-cap of the nine, full at 15 points), R_floor = weighted share met over the floor targets; the reserve counts only as far as the floor targets are met; T5 (05.10.2026): the whole band term is multiplied by G, the weighted share met over the required targets (gate: true) - the score counts only as far as the required targets are met

targets.source: ENDGAME starts at level 100 (user stage definition 30.09.2026)
targets.label: Level
targets.player_why: Most endgame gear, devotions and content assume level 100; the late-game targets of this check start there.

targets.source: Ultimate penalty from balancingadjustment_mp+difficulty_players01.dbr: -50 elemental/acid/pierce, -25 others; cap 80
targets.label: Resistances at 80% on Ultimate
targets.player_why: Ultimate lowers all your resistances by 50 or 25 points; every resistance below 80% lets that damage type hit you much harder.

targets.source: own cap 80 + maximum resistance bonuses (game database)
targets.label: Resistances at your cap
targets.player_why: In the endgame every resistance should sit at your own maximum; each point below lets that damage type through.

targets.source: MID target scaled by level (decision 4.3)

targets.source: MID target scaled by level (decision 4.3)
targets.label: Defensive Ability (combat)
targets.player_why: Defensive Ability target of the Ultimate story, scaled down to your level: it decides how often enemies hit and crit you.

targets.source: Steam: 2,600 plenty for level 100 Ultimate
targets.label: Defensive Ability (combat)
targets.player_why: Defensive Ability decides how often enemies hit and crit you; about 2,600 is plenty at level 100 on Ultimate.

targets.source: Crate forum: at least 3,000; Crate lowers DA by 450
targets.label: Defensive Ability (combat)
targets.player_why: Superbosses lower your Defensive Ability by about 450; with at least 3,000 their critical hits stay rare.

targets.source: most enemies hit physical (community)
targets.label: Physical Res (combat)
targets.player_why: Most enemies deal Physical damage, and Physical Resistance has no cap problem: every point cuts the damage you take most often.

targets.source: user target 30.09.2026 (30%)
targets.label: Physical Res (combat)
targets.player_why: Most endgame damage is Physical; 30% Physical Resistance cuts that damage noticeably.

targets.source: 70% base, bonuses multiply, max 100% (Game Guide); a rest <= 0.5% of Health per physical hit counts as reached
targets.label: Armor Absorption
targets.player_why: Armor removes its value from every physical hit; at 100% absorption it removes the full value instead of only 70%.

targets.source: user target 30.09.2026; hit zones chest 26%, legs 20%, head/shoulders 15%, hands/feet 12%
targets.label: Armor (weighted by hit zone)
targets.player_why: Armor removes a fixed amount from every physical hit - more armor on chest and legs helps most.

targets.source: Loghorrean and Alkamos leech your life
targets.label: Life Leech Res
targets.player_why: Loghorrean and Alkamos drain your life to heal themselves; at least 0% Life Leech Resistance keeps that healing small.

targets.source: leeching superbosses (game database) - user target 03.10.2026 (25, before 50; community 25-30)
targets.label: Life Leech Res
targets.player_why: Several superbosses drain your life to heal themselves; 25% Life Leech Resistance cuts what they take.

targets.source: Crate (crates freeze); CC = no reaction
targets.label: Freeze Res
targets.player_why: Crate's attacks can freeze you; frozen you cannot move or react. 50% Freeze Resistance halves the freeze time.

targets.source: Crate (leap stuns); CC = no reaction
targets.label: Stun Res
targets.player_why: Leap attacks stun you; stunned you cannot move or react. 50% Stun Resistance halves the stun time.

targets.source: decision: Slow Res 50% for SR (community)
targets.label: Slow Res
targets.player_why: Shattered Realm enemies often slow you; 50% Slow Resistance keeps you mobile.

targets.source: user target 30.09.2026: PtH >= 100 vs boss DA 3,000 after your DA shred
targets.label: Hit chance vs boss Defensive Ability 3,000
targets.player_why: Bosses have high Defensive Ability; with too little Offensive Ability your attacks miss more often and crit less.

targets.source: user decision 04.10.2026: the three kinds of enemy resistance reduction on the weakest main damage type, stacking 0.5, reduced 0.3, flat 0.2 (they stack); a kind that is not permanent counts half; target 1.0 = all three, tolerance 0.2
targets.label: Resistance Reduction
targets.player_text: more resistance reduction on your main damage type
targets.player_why: Resistance reduction of all three kinds stacks and raises your damage against every boss. Gear cannot close this - skills, devotions or play style can.

targets.source: community dummy times (Crate forum): the Training Dummy shield (15% life) in about 60 s is fine for the Ultimate story, the reserve is full at 20 s (3 times as fast); HEURISTIC, user decision 04.10.2026
targets.label: Training Dummy shield time
targets.player_why: Your time to the Training Dummy shield measures your whole damage chain. Gear rarely closes this - skills, devotions or play style can.

targets.source: community dummy times (Crate forum): the Training Dummy shield (15% life) in about 30 s is good, 20 s excellent (reserve full at 10 s, 3 times as fast: more damage always helps); HEURISTIC, user decision 04.10.2026
targets.label: Training Dummy shield time
